text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ooh! A camera! It's a fixed camera!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hanyaa~... Flickering~☆ Sparkly~★
Bending all squiggly, rainbow-colored~...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The world through the lens...
...is just so marveloooous, after all...

She stared so intensely into the lens of the city's fixed camera
that she ended up completely disoriented...
